cim: The Future of Tax: Finance, Digitalisation and Artificial Intelligence
cim_eredeti: The Future of Tax: Finance, Digitalisation and Artificial Intelligence
szoveg_eredeti:
The role of tax within a business is expanding beyond calculations and compliance. Today, understanding the financial impact of tax decisions, maintaining data consistency and identifying potential risks early are becoming increasingly important.

In an interview with Tural Jahangirov, Tural Jahangirov, Manager at KPMG Azerbaijan, discusses how finance, digitalisation and artificial intelligence are reshaping the tax function.

The interview explores the link between financial and taxable results, how digital tools can help businesses detect discrepancies, and how AI can support tax professionals in managing requests, analysing information and identifying potential risks proactively.

The interview also highlights why technology should complement, rather than replace, professional judgement in tax decision-making.
